replacements.old: The earlier review identifies a likely second-peak comparator error: the draft's $520$ must not be retained without checking the cited peak definition and dataset.
replacements.new: The earlier comparator's second peak, $520$, was a transcription error. The published Planck positions are $(220.0\pm0.5,\ 537.5\pm0.7,\ 810.8\pm0.7)$ (Planck 2015 results I, Table 7), against the reported SAM peaks $(220,535,812)$, a $-0.47\%$ difference at the second peak, as Chapter~X now states; an identical-estimator reanalysis remains outstanding.

source_verified: Planck Collaboration, Planck 2015 results. I., A&A 594, A1 (2016); arXiv:1502.01582 Table 7 'Planck peak positions and amplitudes': 220.0+-0.5, 537.5+-0.7, 810.8+-0.7 (read 2026-11-02)
